originality.rationale: In the mapping torus of the sphere monodromy, every Weierstrass permutation orbit of size r_j traces a circle projecting to the mapping-torus base with degree r_j, hence its torus crossed with the second S1 has class r_j[T2 x pt]. Excision and integral Thom isomorphism yield H2(Y,U)=Z^c and H1(Y,U)=0, and the intersection map H2(T2 x S2)=Z^2 to Z^c has image generated by (r_1,...,r_c). H1(Y)=Z^2 is free so the exact sequence splits, giving H1(U)=Z^{c+1} plus Z/gcd(r_j). The partition checker only supports arithmetic bookkeeping; the mapping-torus degree and LES are the universal proof.
